'''Trade Federation Factory Turrets''' were defensive [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] emplacements. In use during [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], they were placed to protect a [[Droid factory (Eos)|droid factory]] on [[Eos]]. Although the turrets had limited firing arcs, the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] placed them strategically near the factory to protect all points. Many were destroyed when the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] [[Vana Sage]] and [[Reti]], and [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal escort]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Rhys Dallows]] launched a [[Battle of Eos (Invasion of Naboo)|retaliatory strike]] on the factory.

==Behind the scenes==
The TF Factory Turrets appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]. Although the player is not required to destroy the turrets, the strategy guide recommends doing so to prevent their craft's destruction.
